name: orc_preheated_recuperated_cyclopentane
title: Preheated + recuperated ORC on cyclopentane (Zorlu geothermal site)
summary: Organic Rankine cycle on cyclopentane for the Zorlu geothermal plant: evaporator and condenser each sized by an imposed pinch point (plus superheating / subcooling), constant-isentropic-efficiency pump and expander, constant-effectiveness recuperator (internal heat exchanger) and water preheater, three water sources. The two saturation pressures are the unknowns closed by the two pinch conditions; no pressure drop anywhere. Translation of the LaboThapPy Zorlu ORC example, whose preheater-source bug is corrected here.

origin.course: components: hex_cstpinch.py (HexCstPinch), hex_csteff.py (HexCstEff), pump_csteff.py (PumpCstEff), expander_csteff.py (ExpanderCstEff), same commit f03f7f47; example case study_case = "Zorlu"

verification.reference: Re-run of the source example labothappy/machine/examples/ORC/fpi_orc_example.py (case Zorlu, function preheated_rec_orc) in a throw-away virtual environment (pip install of the local clone, commit f03f7f47; CoolProp 8.0.0, SciPy 1.18.1): converges in 6 Wegstein iterations, PPTD_cond = 5.000000, PPTD_evap = 5.000003. Both the as-shipped main block (preheater source built from the cold-source values, the bug) and the corrected one (T_PRE, p_PRE, m_dot_PRE) were run and compared with the model.
verification.notes: tools/compare_solution.py against the 38 hand-mapped values of the corrected Python run: "38 common variables, 17 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 97". The largest relative deviation (1.93e-01) is on Q_dot_sh_ev (0.197 vs 0.159 MW, 0.29 % of Q_dot_ev); pressures, saturation temperatures, pump power and condenser duties agree to <= 7.1e-04. The deviations above 0.1 % all follow from one stale state of the sequential-modular Python circuit: its evaporator outlet (h_5 = 500644.24 J/kg at 408.5715 K) is 0.5785 K below the state its own pinch residual enforces (T_C_ex = 409.15 K); recomputed with the same CoolProp, enthalpy(Cyclopentane, P=849551 Pa, T=409.15 K) = 501745.38 J/kg = the h_5 of the model, and at 408.5715 K = 500644.16 J/kg = the value stored by Python. See README *Verification*.
